post.caption: Napoleon the Third ordered this diadem for Empress Eugenie in 1853, and the court jeweler Lemonnier set it with 212 pearls and nearly two thousand diamonds. France sold it in the 1887 crown jewels sale, a prince of Thurn and Taxis bought it in 1890 as a wedding gift, and Gloria, nicknamed the Punk Princess, wore it at her wedding in 1980. The Friends of the Louvre bought it in Geneva in 1992.
